content:
Apple's annual major event will be held this Wednesday, when three brand new iPhone models are expected to launch: the iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone 18 Pro Max, and iPhone Ultra. Below is a summary of the expected content.

iPhone 18 Pro 及 Pro Max

iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max will be the successors to Apple's hugely popular 17 Pro series.

Rumoured new features include:

  • A20 Pro chip, with simultaneous improvements in performance and efficiency
  • Major camera upgrades, with the main camera adding a variable aperture
  • Dynamic Island reduced by 35%, for a more modern design
  • New colour options, headlined by a bold wine red
  • The best battery life ever, with the iPhone 18 Pro Max seeing significant improvement
  • Redesigned Camera Control button
  • Apple's in-house C2 cellular modem
  • New satellite features, including 5G support

The starting price of the iPhone 18 Pro is also expected to increase. Outside estimates suggest it could start from US$1,399, but I think the actual pricing is closer to US$1,199 or US$1,249.

iPhone Ultra

The iPhone Ultra is reportedly Apple's first foldable phone, with an expected price tag of over US$2,000, opening up an entirely new premium market.

The foldable design should make the iPhone Ultra Apple's most groundbreaking product to date. It will adopt a wide book-style fold, with an outer screen of around 5.4 inches and an inner screen of around 7.8 inches, much like an iPad mini.

The body materials are expected to follow the iPhone Air, using a titanium frame for a minimalist and stylish look.

The iPhone Ultra will feature two rear cameras (main and ultra-wide) and two front cameras, corresponding to the two screens. Unlocking will switch to Touch ID instead of Face ID.

Software will be the biggest highlight of this device. iOS 27 will support split-screen multitasking and adaptive landscape layouts, perfectly complementing the new form factor.

Performance is expected to match the iPhone 18 Pro, also featuring the A20 Pro chip, with vapour chamber cooling and the C2 modem.

Missing members: iPhone 18 and iPhone Air 2

As usual, the September event should also see the simultaneous launch of the new iPhone 18 base model and the iPhone Air successor.

However, reports indicate that Apple will significantly adjust its autumn product line this year, pushing back the iPhone 18 and iPhone Air 2 to early 2027.

It is currently unclear whether this arrangement is purely a strategic consideration or a forced response to current memory supply constraints. Either way, the absence of more affordable models means this autumn's new iPhone lineup will focus solely on the high-end market.

Are you planning to upgrade to a new iPhone this autumn? Which model is your favourite? Let us know in the comments.

Featured iPhone accessories

  • AirPods Pro 3 (reduced from US$249 to US$199)
  • iPhone magnetic car mount
  • AirTag 10-year battery protective case
  • 100W USB-C fast charging adapter
  • AirTag 2 (4-pack reduced from US$99 to US$79)
